about.title: About Beyond Rasooli
about.founder_bio: Abdul Majeed Rasooli is the creator of Beyond Rasooli, an educational media project exploring psychology, human behaviour, decision-making and the science behind everyday life. Through short videos and accessible articles, he turns research and unusual everyday questions into ideas people can understand and use.
about.mission_text: We believe that understanding why human beings think, remember, choose, and act the way they do is not merely an academic exercise—it is an indispensable tool for living more thoughtfully.
about.principle_1_desc: Every piece begins with credible empirical research, peer-reviewed literature, and foundational academic work. We cite primary sources transparently.
about.principle_2_desc: We translate complex neuroscience and cognitive models into lucid language without stripping away scientific nuance or resorting to superficial life-hacks.
about.principle_3_desc: We ask genuine questions about human nature rather than dispensing unsolicited motivational advice. Our posture is shared inquiry.
about.principle_4_desc: Science is an evolving method, not static dogma. We explicitly distinguish robust consensus from emerging findings and ongoing debates.
about.principle_5_desc: We develop our own editorial concepts, scriptwriting, and visual storytelling without derivative mimicry or outsourced content mills.
about.no_face_note: A note on presentation: Beyond Rasooli intentionally focuses on ideas, hands, environments, archival documents, and cinematic observation—keeping the spotlight entirely on the evidence rather than personal celebrity.
